name: Marrying the Villain
source:
When you go with your hero-crush to stop a supervillain, you expect crime fighting and fun – but it turns out the villain has an unexpected surprise waiting for you.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
跟暗恋的英雄一起去阻止超级反派，你本以为会是一趟打击犯罪、充满乐趣的旅程。谁知，反派却为你准备了一份意料之外的惊喜。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
